policies.description: Anything public: store and route anywhere.
High-volume sensor data: anywhere, latency first (leader acknowledgement is enough).
Indian personal data: stored and routed only inside India.
EU personal data: stored in the EU; may pass through US brokers (e.g. to serve US clients) but never be stored there.
Financial transactions: stored in India and the EU, never stored in or routed through the US; every replica must confirm.
